card.name: Warning and cutoff wording in drug labels
card.fires_on: Words partway through restriction or threshold phrases in drug label warnings, such as 'less' before 'than' in lab cutoffs, 'know' in 'until they know how', or the end of a condition name like infestation.

modes.label: Lab cutoffs
modes.description: Comparison or lab words just before a number or threshold in dosing and exclusion criteria.

modes.label: Driving caution wording
modes.description: Verbs in 'until they know how the drug affects them' warnings.
modes.example: heavy machinery until they<< know>> how fesoterodine fumar

modes.label: Ends of condition names
modes.description: Final or middle pieces of long condition names in warnings about patients with a known condition.
